title: Three statements corrected to match the shipped state
detail: The trust page no longer says the apex domain is unresolved; the application page no longer states a reply deadline the terms contradict; the pricing intro no longer says check frequency varies by plan.

title: The application form works without JavaScript
detail: The form is now part of the static HTML and posts natively to the Probe service, which redirects to a confirmation page. Structured data, llms.txt and a per-page sitemap lastmod date were added.

title: Probe private preview deployed
detail: A Cloudflare Worker with D1 now runs scheduled HTTP checks, opens one incident after three consecutive failures, posts to one HTTPS webhook and publishes a sanitized status page per account. Manual activation only.

title: Probe access page and application flow published
detail: Three fixed sizes with endpoint and retention limits. The application form posts to the Probe service; nothing is charged during the preview and no payment is taken on this site.

title: Probe record moves from Planned to private preview
detail: Implemented checks, incident rule, webhook, SSRF rejection and stale-state handling are now listed as implemented. TLS expiry and the split between collector and publisher remain planned.

title: Public copy rewritten around reader questions
detail: The home page now starts with the failure modes the modules are designed for, then states what each module would do. All four remain Planned.

title: Claims register published
detail: Every public claim now has a page, a stage and an evidence status. Claims without evidence are marked as such.

title: Documentation aligned with the public stage model
detail: Region, price, SLA and contact claims were removed pending evidence. The documentation now describes intended design only.

title: Product pages add use cases, design decisions and open questions
detail: Each module page now records why its boundary is drawn where it is, and what is still undecided.

title: Five production blockers recorded
detail: Legal entity, security reporting channel, domain verification, Lighthouse results and the operating entity are still open.

title: Public site rebuilt around product stages and boundaries
detail: The site is a static export. It has no account, API key, payment flow or live product endpoint.
